card.name: Patent phrasing and label section cross-references
card.fires_on: Words inside the stock patent phrase "best be understood by reference to the following detailed description... when read in conjunction with", and digits inside section cross-references like "(12.2)". It also fires on scattered name pieces such as Tok or von.

modes.label: Patent phrase
modes.description: Words in the stock sentence about understanding the invention by reference to the detailed description when read with the drawings.

modes.label: Section cross-reference digits
modes.description: A digit within a parenthesized label section number that points to another section of the label.

modes.label: Parts of names
modes.description: The middle piece of a person's name or a drug name.

card.writes: It suppresses words about numbers and references, which suggests it moves the output away from numbering or reference words.
card.plain: It lights up on the stock patent sentence and on the numbers inside section cross-references in drug labels.
